{{Top|leg}}
'''Corellian Merchants' Guildhouses''' were located throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They offered services such as lodging, trade contacts, information, and [[Starship/Legends|starship]] maintenance services to [[Corellian Merchants' Guild/Legends|Corellian Merchants' Guild]] members, usually at rates far lower than local prices.
